record.title: graphite · chen-2020 · analytical formula

temperature.description: Not established from the upstream OCP function; no temperature dependence supplied.

x.definition: Electrode lithium fraction c_s/c_s,max as defined by the upstream implementation; not whole-cell SOC.
x.domain_basis: Mathematical stoichiometry interval; an experimentally validated fitting interval is not established here.

cell_link.evidence: Upstream function docstring identifies LG M50; exact specimen and batch are not established.

processing.changes: Renamed sto to x; removed numpy namespace. Coefficients unchanged.

limitations: No raw experimental points are claimed for this expression.
No separate lithiation/delithiation branch or temperature law is supplied.
Not a complete or independently validated cell parameter set.
Effective commercial negative-electrode formula; do not interpret as a universal pure-graphite material law.

chen-2020.title: Development of Experimental Techniques for Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models
chen-2020.role: Scientific attribution of the LG M50 graphite OCP and non-OCP parameter implementations; individual measurement/fit/borrowing origins not independently audited.

pybamm-25-4-2.title: PyBaMM v25.4.2: pinned lithium-ion parameter implementations
